session.title: User authentication with JWT session tokens

parts.text: We need to pick how users authenticate to the API. Options: long-lived opaque tokens, JWT access tokens, or server sessions with refresh tokens.

For user sessions the team decided to ship JWT access tokens with a sliding refresh-token flow. Rationale: stateless verification for the API, short-lived access tokens expiring in thirty minutes, refresh rotation on every use, and revocation at refresh time. Alternatives considered: opaque session tokens and long-lived JWTs without refresh.
